question: What fluorine mass ratio was measured on the surface of the cathode rejects, and what after the Cyrene separation?
rendered: The mass ratio of fluorine element on the surface of the cathode rejects was 12.49%, and that value was greatly reduced to 0.14% after the Cyrene-based separation process.
